run_train_model: run the cli_main function to train a new model on one or multiple GPUs
run_distributed_training: run the distributed_main function to spawn multi-GPU training processes across available devices
run_validate_model: run the validate function to evaluate the model on validation subsets and return losses
run_validate_and_save: run the validate_and_save function to validate the model and save checkpoints at intervals
run_early_stopping: run the should_stop_early function to check if training should stop based on validation patience
